comments.text: Took the bus to Cono Norte from the centre of town and then walked a few minutes. Barely had time to drop our bags and lift our thumbs that an Italian tourist with a rented car stopped to give us a lift. The road between Arequipa and Puno is absolutely gorgeous!
comments.textFr: Took the bus to Cono Norte from the centre of town and then walked a few minutes. Barely had time to drop our bags and lift our thumbs that an Italian tourist with a rented car stopped to give us a lift. The road between Arequipa and Puno is absolutely gorgeous!
comments.textEn: Took the bus to Cono Norte from the center of town and then walked a few minutes. Barely had time to drop our bags and lift our thumbs that an Italian tourist with a rented car stopped to give us a lift. The road between Arequipa and Puno is absolutely gorgeous!
comments.textEs: Tomó el autobús hasta Cono Norte desde el centro de la ciudad y luego caminó unos minutos. Apenas tuvimos tiempo de dejar las maletas y levantar los pulgares cuando un turista italiano con un coche alquilado se detuvo para llevarnos. ¡La carretera entre Arequipa y Puno es absolutamente hermosa!
comments.textDe: Bin mit dem Bus vom Stadtzentrum nach Cono Norte gefahren und dann ein paar Minuten gelaufen. Wir hatten kaum Zeit, unser Gepäck abzustellen und den Daumen zu heben, als ein italienischer Tourist mit einem Mietwagen anhielt, um uns mitzunehmen. Die Straße zwischen Arequipa und Puno ist einfach wunderschön!
